## Follow-up Comments
Initialize the system message from the call options.
`262-262`: ** Major** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Initialize the system message from the call options.** The live-call engine stores the resolved prompt in `llm_options["system_prompt"]`, while `context_for_llm` contains conversation history and continuation data. `OllamaLLMAdapter._compose_options()` merges the runtime options, but `generate()` reads the prompt only from `context`. When the session has no existing system message, the live call can omit the configured system message, so `_recent_messages()` has no system message to preserve. The lookup at `src/pipelines/ollama.py:262` is pre-existing. This PR does not introduce the prompt omission, but its trimming fix is ineffective on this live-call path. Read the prompt from `merged`, or copy it into `context_for_llm`. Add a regression test that starts with an empty session and checks the outgoing request for the system message.
Suggested localized fix
```diff - system_prompt = context.get("system_prompt", "") + system_prompt = merged.get("system_prompt") or context.get("system_prompt", "") ```
[Open the source location](https://github.com/hkjarral/AVA-AI-Voice-Agent-for-Asterisk/blob/983491fdc88c9db31e9fcd3f51aca296afabbc4f/src/pipelines/ollama.py#L262)
